# Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County

> > The Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County (NHM) in Exposition Park features world-class dinosaur exhibits, natural history collections, and interactive experiences exploring Southern California's biodiversity and Earth's history.

Founded in 1913, NHM houses iconic permanent exhibits including Dinosaur Hall with T. rex specimens, the Nature Gardens showcasing native California ecosystems, and special exhibitions like Unearthed and Becoming Jane. The museum serves as both a premier visitor destination and active research institution with collections documenting Los Angeles County's natural and cultural heritage.

## Key Topics

- Dinosaur Hall and T. rex specimens
- Exposition Park campus location
- Unearthed: Raw Beauty exhibition
- Nature Gardens and native California ecosystems
- First Fridays after-hours events
- Gnatalie (giant ground sloth)
- P-22 (famous LA mountain lion)
- Free admission programs for LA County residents
- Educational field trips and school programs
- Butterfly Pavilion seasonal exhibit
- Seaver Center for Western History Research
- DISCO (Diversity Initiative for Southern California Ocean)
- Nature Lab with live LA wildlife
- Museum research and collections

## Visitor Information

- [Natural History Museum](https://nhm.org): Homepage showcasing Dino Hall, Unearthed exhibition, and current events
- [Plan Your Visit](https://nhm.org/plan-your-visit): Essential visitor info: hours, admission, parking, directions for NHM
- [Buy Tickets](https://nhm.org/plan-your-visit/nhm-buy-tickets): Ticket purchase portal for general admission and member access to NHM
- [Free Hours and Admission](https://nhm.org/free-hours-and-admission): Free admission programs for LA County residents, teachers, and military

## Exhibitions & Experiences

- [Experience NHM](https://nhm.org/experience-nhm): Main exhibitions hub featuring Unearthed, Dino Hall, and Nature Gardens
- [Exhibitions at the Natural History Museum](https://nhm.org/experience-nhm/exhibitions-natural-history-museum): Complete exhibitions directory: special, permanent, dinosaurs, LA history
- [Nature Lab](https://nhm.org/nature-lab): Hands-on lab with live LA wildlife: spiders, snakes, opossums, and owls

## Events & Programs

- [NHM First Fridays 2026](https://nhm.org/first-fridays): 20th anniversary of LA's premier after-hours museum event with music & talks
- [Dino Fest](https://nhm.org/dinofest): Annual dinosaur festival with paleontologists and rare Cretaceous fossils
- [Haunted Museum 2024](https://nhm.org/haunted-museum): Halloween 2024 event with scavenger hunt and Boney Island access

## Educational Resources

- [Field Trip Booking Form 2025–2026](https://nhm.org/form/nhm-field-trip-booking-form-2025-2026): Field trip booking form for 2025-2026 CA school groups (PreK-12)
- [Field Trip FAQs](https://nhm.org/educational-resources/nhm-field-trips/field-trip-faqs): School field trip FAQs for CA PreK-12 groups visiting NHM
- [Rocks & Minerals: An Exploratory Guide](https://nhm.org/learning-resource/rocks-minerals-exploratory-guide): Educational guide on igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic rocks for students
- [Outdoor Exploration Guide](https://nhm.org/learning-resource/outdoor-exploration-guide): Pre-K-5 nature observation guide for outdoor sensory learning activities
- [How To: Set up an Animal Track Station](https://nhm.org/learning-resource/how-set-animal-track-station): Field guide for creating wildlife track stations and monitoring animals

## Research & Collections

- [DISCO](https://research.nhm.org/disco): Diversity Initiative for Southern California Ocean research and digitization
- [The Evolution of Dr. Jane Goodall](https://nhm.org/stories/evolution-dr-jane-goodall): Jane Goodall's chimpanzee research and Becoming Jane exhibition coverage
- [The Beginnings of Butterflies](https://nhm.org/stories/beginnings-butterflies): Study by Vijay Barve traces butterfly origins to North America 100M years ago

## About NHM

- [The NHM Story](https://nhm.org/nhm-story): Museum history from 1913 founding in Exposition Park to present day
- [About Exposition Park](https://nhm.org/about-exposition-park): Info on 160-acre campus housing NHM, Science Center, and Coliseum

## Optional

- [Museum Shop FAQ](https://shop.nhm.org/faq): Museum shop FAQ for merchandise, gifts, and NHM-themed products
- [Seaver Center FAQ](https://nhm.org/seaver-center-faq): Seaver Center for Western History Research access and usage FAQ
